crossRefs.note: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this…

parallels.note: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gezer
people.line: A Canaanite city, conquered by Joshua and later by David.

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: David did so, as Yahweh commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.
translations.bsb: So David did as the LORD had commanded him, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
translations.kjv: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.
translations.asv: And David did so, as Jehovah commanded him, and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gezer.
